events.label: Terra Nova FPSO refit
events.text: The Terra Nova FPSO went offline in January 2020 for a life-extension refit and resumed production in November 2023. The refit extends production to 2033.

events.label: SeaRose FPSO refit
events.text: The refit of the SeaRose FPSO took White Rose and North Amethyst offline in January 2024; production resumed in March 2025. Together with the West White Rose extension it supports production from White Rose until 2038.

reservoirProps._note: Fra provinsens faktaark (februar 2023), kontrollert mot bildet av arket. producing=false: «Reservoirs have not been placed on production» per 2023. For North Amethyst gjentar arket Terra Novas verdier for «Jeanne d'Arc, Beothuk Mbr.»; den kolonnen er utelatt.

north-amethyst.note: The provincial sheet also lists «Jeanne d'Arc, Beothuk Mbr.» for North Amethyst with exactly Terra Nova's values; it is left out here as an apparent copy error. North Amethyst also produces from the Hibernia Formation (since 2016).

hebron.note: Hebron is the province's first heavy-oil field (CER). The sheet marks all three formations as «multiple pools in distinct fields» and as not yet on production, which in 2023 was only true of parts of them: Ben Nevis has produced since 2017, and Jeanne d'Arc and Hibernia since 2021–2022 (C-NLOER production data).
